# IconButton

> A round button with only an icon, including a Project type for sitting on top of images.

| Kind | component |

| Implemented in | Portfolio site (`src/rost/icon-button/IconButton.tsx`, `.rost-icon-button`) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | `Primary` `Project` `Secondary` `Tertiary` | `Primary` |
| `icon` | slot |  |  |

## States

`Default` · `Hover` · `Pressed` · `Focus` · `Disabled`

## Anatomy

- `root`
- `icons-arrow-left`: The icon slot, 20px (16px on the Project type). Its colour is the action's `icon` token, per type and state.
- `glyph`: Figma's arrow, drawn as a mask in the icon's colour so one file serves every state. A caller's own icon replaces it and should use `currentColor`.
- `background`: The see-through fill under Secondary and Tertiary, and under Project on hover and press, on its own layer so the icon stays solid.
- `focus-ring`

## When to use

- **Actions everyone knows.** Actions everyone knows where a label would crowd things: close, back, next, previous.
- **On top of a picture.** `Project` on top of imagery: thumbnails and cards.

## When not to use

- **An icon that needs explaining.** Any icon that isn't instantly obvious. Use **Button** with a label, an icon isn't one.
- **On or off.** On/off or one-of-many choices. That's **Toggle**. IconButton does something, it doesn't remember anything.

## Behaviour

`type` is `Primary`, `Secondary`, `Tertiary` or `Project`. States come from the browser like every other action. Primary, Secondary and Tertiary are 40px, and that's the floor: fingers need the room. Project is 32px because it sits inside a project row, and the whole row is the target there.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: `<button type="button">`.
- **Name**: `aria-label` is a must, there's no visible text. Say what it does ("Close dialog"), not what it shows ("X").
- **Keyboard**: Enter and Space.
- **Focus**: `focus-ring`, on `:focus-visible`.
- **Tooltip**: give it a tooltip with the same words, once there's a **Tooltip** in the kit.

## Content

No text. The `aria-label` follows the same rules as Button.

## No token, on purpose

| Part | Property | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `glyph` | `mask` | `url(./icon-arrow-left.svg) center / contain no-repeat` | The icon file itself. `assets/icons/arrow-left.svg`, the same shape Figma uses (its insets match Figma's `Union` layer exactly). |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--icon-button-primary-default-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--icon-button-primary-hover-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--icon-button-primary-pressed-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--icon-button-primary-disabled-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
| `root` | `box-shadow` | `inset var(--spacing-outline-small) var(--spacing-outline-small) 0 0 var(--icon-button-primary-focus-outline)` | Figma's 1px left and top stroke, drawn inside the shape as Figma draws it. The width and colour are tokens. |
| `focus-ring` | `inset` | `calc(-1 * var(--spacing-gap-2xsmall))` | Composed from a token: spacing/gap/2xsmall out. Figma said -5px on the left and top, to make up for the stroke, which takes no space here. |
| `focus-ring` | `inset` | `calc(-1 * var(--spacing-gap-2xsmall))` | Composed from a token: the ring sits spacing/gap/2xsmall outside the element. |
| `focus-ring` | `inset` | `calc(-1 * var(--spacing-gap-2xsmall))` | Composed from a token: the ring sits spacing/gap/2xsmall outside the element. |
